body: How Python does AI. Agents, realtime voice, image generation, embeddings. Every model, every interface, typed end to end.
plain_description: **Build AI agents that turn business requests into typed, validated results.** Use them for data extraction, customer support, voice interactions, and long-running workflows. Connect the same agent to different models and interfaces.
technical_description: Pydantic AI is a typed Python SDK for building AI agents across model providers. It supports tools, structured outputs, model fallbacks, realtime voice, image generation, embeddings, and integrations for web, CLI, UI, and durable workflows. Pydantic AI Harness adds capabilities such as memory, guardrails, planning, persistence, and coding agents; related packages provide evaluation and graph-based control flow.
title: Pydantic AI
